_note: Source of truth for the writing cards on the home page and the reading pages. Run python3 scripts/build-site.py after editing. Every word shown is Mike's own: 'passage' is lifted verbatim from the piece ([[ ]] marks the highlighted phrase, ' … ' a cut, a newline a line break); 'dek' is the piece's own subtitle, where it has one. 'format', 'client' and 'published' are the three labels; 'tag' is the name on the card's cursor. A piece with 'file' gets a reading page at writing/<slug>/; one with only 'href' links out.

pieces.title: The AI detector dilemma
pieces.passage: Using an AI detector to catch a modern LLM is [[like sending a 1990s-era MS Office Paperclip Helper to fight a T1000]] from the Terminator movies. The LLM is a trillion-parameter model trained on supercomputer clusters; the detector is a thin classifier guessing from shallow patterns.

pieces.title: Multiplayer Pencil
pieces.passage:
Multiplayer Pencil.
AI-infused marketing mind meld loading.
The limitless possibility-space of AI-enabled creation can feel bewildering. [[Don’t fly in solo.]] Bring your creative crew along on the AI journey.
Book a Demo today!

pieces.title: Reimagining mining and climate
pieces.dek: Africa’s social and economic imperatives are as important as the energy transition.
pieces.passage: In Africa, there are foundational elements of social and economic development, which are equally if not more important than the energy transition. … From a South African perspective, coal remains a critical commodity to help us reliably navigate the energy transition – [[we cannot simply switch it off.]]

pieces.title: Blood, Books and Bots
pieces.passage: AI is not cheating. AI is not moral decay. It’s not a moral virtue either. It’s technology. It’s a tool. [[AI is the new brush.]] The new pen, the new keyboard, and the new camera.

pieces.title: “Then I Knew I Was Good at Painting”
pieces.passage: Transcending the boundaries of canvas and mural, Mahlangu’s work displays [[an inimitable fluency across diverse mediums]], from small, treasured keepsakes to vast public installations and murals.

pieces.title: “What in the SMR…?!”
pieces.dek: Small Reactors, Big Stakes: Understanding the SMR Gold Rush
pieces.passage: Generative AI and the digital economy are advancing at breakneck pace, but looming energy shortfalls could thwart Big Tech’s best-laid plans for expansion. The worldwide race for reliable, clean energy has become [[a high-stakes game where digital progress and climate survival hang in the balance.]]

pieces.title: Baby Rose: SA swimstar
pieces.passage: Her infectious joy and indefatigable spirit are inspirational. [[The ripples of her laughter and the splashes of her tiny hands]] vividly remind us that there is always hope, even in the darkest moments of despair.

pieces.title: A symphony of solutions
pieces.credit: Written on behalf of Alberto Gambacorta, Scatec’s VP of project development for sub-Saharan Africa.
pieces.passage: The government must grapple with [[a complex balancing act]], reconciling the urgent need for energy security in the face of some of the world’s worst loadshedding, with the need to secure long-term sustainability.

pieces.title: Risen from the sea
pieces.passage: Imagine gazing out at a sunset that cascades over the ocean, viewed from the summit of a majestic flat-topped peak that has stood as witness to the passage of time for hundreds of millions of years. [[This is Table Mountain.]]

pieces.title: Why you can’t trust Grok 4’s benchmarks
pieces.passage: On paper, this suggests Musk’s creation might be one of the most powerful AI models yet developed. [[In practice, however]], the announcement has been met with significant skepticism from the AI community and users alike.

pieces.title: Changing the beat of hospitality
pieces.credit: Written on behalf of, and in collaboration with, Leonie Andereya of Radisson RED.
pieces.passage: Such are the dreary narratives of yesteryear, but it’s time to throw those out, [[like so many soiled linens.]] Enter 2023, the year of good news.

pieces.title: Africa Health 2024 relocates to Cape Town
pieces.passage: Now, in a significant shift, Africa Health 2024 is set to be hosted in Cape Town, following previous years’ events in Johannesburg. This marks [[the first time the conference will be held in the Mother City.]]

pieces.title: Chef Andre Hill celebrates the flavours of Cape Town
pieces.passage: From home-cooked Cape Malay flavours to the world’s finest tables, Andre Hill’s journey reminds us that [[food transcends boundaries.]]

pieces.title: SAPVIA shares insights from localisation study
pieces.dek: Calls for solar PV value chain development support
pieces.credit: Written on behalf of the South African Photovoltaic Industry Association.
pieces.passage: If we’re not careful, it’s the people of South Africa looking to make their households resilient against load shedding, who could ultimately bear the additional costs. … [[The catch-22 is not intractable.]]

pieces.title: Pioneering progress
pieces.dek: Amid resource constraints in African radiology and oncology
pieces.passage: As the continent grapples with the rising burden of cancer, the intersection of oncology and radiology emerges as a complex landscape where [[cutting-edge advancements contend with pressing issues of accessibility]], affordability, and healthcare system economics.

pieces.title: Committed to conservation
pieces.passage: Maintaining this sanctuary in its pristine natural state over the past nine decades – as the city below expanded into the bustling metropolis we know and love today – is [[a remarkable feat of long-term conservation]] and sustainable tourism.
